title: Underlying Lean Graph of Libraries

libraryFactorizationProfile.authority: read-only derived view; never replaces Lean source, declarations, imports, or checker replay
definitions: S_t: transitive support of selected target t
r(v): number of selected targets whose support contains node v
I = sum_t |S_t| = sum_v r(v): expanded support incidences
P_share = sum_v binom(r(v),2) = sum_{s<t}|S_s intersect S_t|: pairwise sharing mass
libraryFactorizationProfile.antiGaming: metrics remain a vector; node minimization or fan-out maximization alone is not a valid optimization objective

futureEvidenceUpgrade: export theorem-level dependencies from elaborated Lean proof terms
apply the same factorization definitions to theorem support DAGs
record evidence layer and target policy with every historical metric snapshot
